Data Scientist, Medisure — Jun 2025 - Present
At Medisure I build and deploy predictive models for claims fraud detection and patient risk stratification. Led development of a PyTorch-based neural network that improved early-risk identification recall by 12% on holdout data. Implemented end-to-end data pipelines using SQL and pandas to aggregate and clean multi-source claims and EHR data for model training, reducing data preparation time by 40%. Produced reproducible training and evaluation workflows in Python and PyTorch, versioned with Git, and documented experiments and runbooks in Confluence. Collaborated with product and operations teams using Jira to triage model issues and manage delivery of two ML features into production.

Skills: Python, Machine Learning, pandas, SQL, PyTorch, Confluence, Jira, Git
